text:
Impossible mother: blinded well, broken amphora,

submerged cathedral...

Water above you... and salt. And the remote

sunlight that never quite reaches you. Life

does not pass from your breast; in you Life strikes

and rebounds, then leaves diverted, lost,

to one side-to one side...

Toward where?...

Like Night, you pass over the earth

leaving no traces

of your shadow; and to the bloodied cry

of Life, your life does not answer,

deaf with the divine deafness of the stars...

translation.title: Song to the Sterile Woman
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the historical title and the cosmic imagery while keeping the voice elegiac rather than clinical.
